description: Create a queued security scan on a release. version (release label) is required. Provide exactly one of dastCheckConfig, sastCheckConfig, depsCheckConfig, or leaksCheckConfig. Returns { scanId, prompt }. Then run /testchimp run security scan for <scanId> (run-release-check). Ask the user before creating DAST scans.
name: create-security-scan
title: Create Security Scan
